subject: Post-demo: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up (HIPAA / SOC2 / BAA)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up (HIPAA / SOC2 / BAA)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Really appreciated the clear context on Acme Health's workflows and the compliance bar you're operating under. Quick recap and next steps from our side so we can make the technical and contractual path forward as smooth as possible.

Recap of deployment options we discussed (high-level):
- Hosted API: fastest to production, fully managed by Redwood. Can be used for non-PHI or with a signed BAA + additional controls for some PHI use cases, but typically not first choice for covered-entity PHI flows.
- Dedicated (Reserved Capacity): single-tenant GPU pools with stronger logical isolation, SLA-backed throughput. Good middle ground for customers who need predictable performance and BAA coverage; faster to stand up than Private.
- Private (VPC / On‑prem): customer-hosted control plane / on-prem options for the highest isolation and auditability. Best fit when you require strict network controls, data residency, custom KMS/HSM integration, or need to have Redwood run inside your VPC or on-prem rack.

Compliance/evidence checklist we typically provide and that you asked about:
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted summary attached; full report available under NDA)
- Sample BAA (attached) and our engagement/controls language
- Audit logs & retention options (we support configurable retention; we can add a 7-year retention policy as an add-on)
- Network diagrams / data flow (we can provide templates and will need your architecture to validate)
- KMS/HSM integration (BYOK supported for Private & Dedicated deployments)

As next steps, please confirm the following so we can scope the right track:
1) Preferred deployment target: Hosted API | Dedicated | Private (VPC/on-prem) — if you select Private, please indicate VPC or fully on-prem.
2) Timeline for compliance/audit (target go‑live / vendor review date).
3) Any procurement constraints (e.g., PO terms, required vendor forms) — loop in procurement if you'd like us to send the BAA for review.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf, Redwood_BAA-sample.pdf, deployment_options_onepager.pdf

If helpful, I can set up a 60‑minute technical scoping workshop with Dylan (Solutions Eng) and Rishi (Customer Success) next week to walk through network/KMS options and the mutual action plan.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:46:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up (HIPAA / SOC2 / BAA)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Acme Health is a covered entity; we need a BAA and will only consider production handling of PHI under a Private (VPC or on‑prem) deployment. Dedicated with a signed BAA could work for an initial POC, but long term we expect Private.
- SOC 2 Type II is required (we will want the full report under NDA).
- We require vendor access logs and audit trails to be retained for at least 7 years. Is that supported?
- Does Redwood support BYOK with HSM integration for encryption at rest? We need to integrate with our HyTrust HSM or Azure Key Vault HSM.
- For procurement: we will need a preliminary cost estimate for both (a) Dedicated POC (monthly committed capacity) and (b) full Private VPC deployment (CAPEX / professional services estimate).

Can we schedule the technical workshop you mentioned? Prefer next Thursday or Friday in the morning PT. Also please send the BAA to procurement (procurement@acmehealth.com) so we can start internal legal review.

Thanks —
Samantha Lee
Director of Engineering, Acme Health
samantha.lee@acmehealth.com | (650) 555-9201

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up (HIPAA / SOC2 / BAA)

Hi Samantha —

Great, thanks for the clarifications — all feasible. Short answers first, then proposed next steps:

Answers:
- BAA: yes, we can execute a BAA. I attached a sample; we’ll also send the formal BAA to procurement as requested.
- SOC2 Type II: we can provide the full report under NDA. The redacted summary is attached for initial review.
- 7-year log retention: supported as a configurable retention policy (add-on) — we’ll include pricing in the estimate.
- BYOK / HSM: supported for Private VPC and for Dedicated in most setups. We integrate with common KMS/HSM providers (Azure Key Vault HSM, AWS CloudHSM, customer-hosted HSMs) — Dylan will cover specifics in the workshop.

Proposed next steps (pick one):
A) POC path (faster): Dedicated reserved capacity + signed BAA, 3‑month POC with scoped throughput and test data. Lower initial commitment, shorter procurement cycle.
B) Full Private path: Private VPC or on‑prem deployment, includes professional services for installation and KMS integration. Longer lead time (4–8 weeks for network & compliance setup) but meets long‑term requirements.

We suggest running the technical scoping workshop next Friday, 2026-07-17 at 10:00 AM PT — would that work? During the session we’ll cover network diagrams, expected throughput/QPS, sequence lengths and PII patterns, KMS options, and audit logging details.

I’ve created a mutual action plan and shared it here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDEFghIJkLMnoPqR/mutual-action-plan. I’ll also start a DocuSign flow for the BAA and the draft SOW once you confirm the path (A or B) and procurement contact.

Estimated next deliverables after your confirmation:
- Technical workshop invite (calendar)
- Draft SOW / cost estimate for selected path
- DocuSign BAA for procurement review

Thanks — looping Rishi and Dylan to coordinate the workshop.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0142

I'll prepare:
- SOC2 evidence list and our controls mapping (we have a redacted SOC2_typeII_report_redacted.pdf ready under NDA)
- KMS/HSM integration options and a short integration checklist
- Estimated timeline for Private VPC onboarding and a sample network ACL playbook

Let's confirm the calendar invite and a 30‑minute pre-read; I’ll attach the SOC2 redacted PDF in the workshop deck and bring the KMS integration notes.

Thanks,
